title: Seasonal Runway: Q3 plan for endpoint stability, model migration, and capacity hedges
creator: Asha Patel
description: This ticket coordinates a cross-functional Q3 playbook to (1) stabilize hosted endpoints during peak seasonal traffic, (2) stage and execute a phased model migration for two primary model families, and (3) put in place capacity hedges to avoid SLA regressions. The goal is predictable latency and cost during migration windows while minimizing tail-risk from model incompatibilities and capacity churn.
acceptance_criteria: Canaries for model migration run for 72 hours with p95 latency within 5% of baseline
Automated rollback policy triggers and verified fallback to previous model variant within 30s for >=95% of failures
Capacity hedge plan (reserved burst nodes + autoscale policy) demonstrated in simulation at 2x expected QPS
Runbook documented and validated in tabletop exercise with SRE, ML-Ops, and Support
Cost impact estimate for migration < 8% incremental token cost and approved by finance

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Kernel incompatibility causes silent correctness regressions. Mitigation: add structured output validation and regression evals against golden prompt set before canary rollout.
Risk: Burst capacity unavailable in target region. Mitigation: pre-provision reserved capacity and cross-region fallback routes; document failover sequence.
Risk: Increased unit cost during dual-serving. Mitigation: define cost cap and phased ramp with finance approval. Run daily cost delta checks during canary.
